correctness.rationale: Munn tree parity across cuts gives a sharp 2E-d length bound. Equality forces every trunk edge exactly once and each branch edge twice, hence unique sequential trunk advancement and independent ordered depth-first exploration of off-trunk children. The exact factorial bijection counts all such walks once, with distinct edge labels distinguishing different orders. R/L/D class sums use endpoint eccentricities, inversion and ordered diametral pairs, with nontrivial finite-tree translation stabilizers excluded. The formal excursion recurrence uses falling factorials (choice plus order) with unique positive-degree recursion; trunk length decomposition is unique and sums as a geometric series. An independent exhaustive 87,381-word rank-two check up to length eight matches H/R/L/D multiplicities and all algebraic-series coefficients, but this bounded computation is not used as infinite proof. Independent checks in rank one (through length 12) and rank three (through length 6) agree with the algebraic series.

value.rationale: The number of shortest spellings for a fixed free-inverse-monoid element is a natural ambiguity measure missing from element spherical growth and Green-language complexity. It is exactly classified for every birooted finite Munn tree and all Green classes, including the non-context-free Green languages. The weighted recursive decomposition additionally computes the exact length enumeration of all geodesic WORDS for every finite rank and proves its algebraicity, a nontrivial quantitative refinement of recent language-theoretic results. No unjustified claim about asymptotic constants, arbitrary quotients or new word-length minima is made.
